title: Permission explanation
reasoningOffMetadataWarning: Local metadata marks disabling reasoning or reasoning_effort as unsupported. This explicit compatibility test overrides that declaration for explanations only; it does not establish upstream support. Cancel keeps your settings unchanged.
reasoningOffConfirm: Send reasoning_effort=none only for this provider/model on OpenAI Completions. Relay/upstream support is unverified; it may reject or ignore the parameter. No automatic retry or fallback. Other models keep Pi's mapping. This changes only explanation settings and sends no test request.
saved: Settings saved. Applies to the next explanation.
search: Search model name, ID or provider
navigation: Up/Down: select | Enter: change | Esc: back
modelHint: Only affects explanations, not the primary session model.
routed: Routed by Pi; actual model, cost and recipient may differ
cached: Session cache: same known input, not a new safety assessment
truncated: Output reached its limit or was shortened for display; it may be incomplete.
retry: Press the shortcut to retry explicitly; no automatic fallback.
configInvalid: Invalid permission-explain.json. Last valid settings retained, or explanations disabled if none exist. Repair the file or open settings.
configSaveFailed: Could not save settings; previous settings remain active.
modelUnavailable: Selected model is unavailable. No fallback request was sent.
noModel: No current model. Select an explanation model in settings.
reasoningOverrideUnsupported: Explicit none requires an OpenAI Completions request for the bound model. Model/API mismatch or unrecognized payload; no request sent.
reasoningOverrideConflict: Explicit none conflicts with other thinking parameters. No request sent.
inputTooLong: Input exceeds maxInputChars. Nothing sent; input was not truncated.
unsafeInput: Cannot safely prepare this input (control characters). Nothing sent.
timeout: Explanation timed out. Approval follows its own timeout; cancellation may still incur cost.
emptyOutput: Model returned no explanation text. No continuation request was sent.
requestFailed: Explanation failed. No retry or model fallback was attempted.
unsupported: Unsupported tool or insufficient public command context. No model request.
repairPrompt: This overwrites only permission-explain.json with defaults, including following the current model. Cancel to repair the file manually.
tuiOnly: This command is available only in interactive TUI mode.
busy: Settings cannot open while a permission prompt is active.
noDiagnostics: No request measured yet. Trigger an explanation, then run this command again.
